title: Her Last Favor waits for its story
caption: At Lv 30 on Canyon's Secret, Her Last Favor is no longer offered early: it opens once Canyon's Secret is turned in, as in game.

title: Fight Poison with Poison opens sooner
caption: At Lv 27, Fight Poison with Poison is offered while A Collective Effort is your quest, since the game opens it at that quest's fourth step.
